objective: Execute the already frozen B50 adjacent-lower budget at the same three seeds through V744's unchanged clean-start training lineage after B60 passed all three seeds on v21.
decision_rule: Each seed must start from the same immutable pre-V443 checkpoint and execute every unchanged V744 stage. After all three complete, no lineage result is promoted directly: the exact frozen packages must undergo one separately preregistered full 4,200-row v21 screen. If B50 passes all three, B50 is a stable sufficient candidate but no minimum is established without an adjacent-lower all-seed failure. If B50 fails all three while B60 passes all three, B60 is the stable minimum. A mixed B50 result stops without a minimum.
claim_boundary: B50 clean-start training authorization only. No B50 result, minimum, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4, or ABI-superiority claim.
